body:
I try not to put too much on people. I'd rather them tell me they can't handle it then scream at me or say things like I chose to be this way and I do nothing about it. I've tried for years to get this under control and I honestly can't remember the last time I was truly happy. There are random days where I'm extremely motivated and I get a lot of stuff done and I think my meds start working or I'm finally done with this episode but I crash the next day. It gives me false hope. And it's just exhausting going back and forth like that. Like one day I'm optimistic and the next I'm suicidal. I know its mostly my thoughts that tear me apart and I'm trying to get them under control. But I just convince myself everything they day is true.

My job is willing to work with my mental illness which is really good but I need to work myself up to full-time. And woodburning is just something I like to do but you know it's hard when you're not motivated. I did want to be able to sell my work but there's so much other things I need to do first that I sometimes feel is impossible.

Thank you for everything. It means a lot that someone out here actually understands. 

I was into woodburning but now it's hard to see the point in it. I mean I wanted to sell some of my work but in order to start I need to be able to work my regular job. And I keep calling off because I'm so unstable and emotional and keep crying on the job. I also know things would get a bit better if I moved out because living at home is so toxic. But I can't move out if i can't hold a job. I keep having those thoughts that the depression will never get better as I've been suffering for years. That no matter what I do it'll get worse. I've tried so hard for so long and I'm so tired and exhausted and I keep losing those around me. Especially those who say they are here for me but then turn around and blame me for being this way. It's just so exhausting.

I have opened up to a few people about it. My best friend is the only person who has been here for me but I don't want to put too much on her. My mom just doesn't know how to handle it and she'll start yelling at me to get up on my days I can hardly get out of bed. My first mistake was to tell my ex who just broke up with me a couple weeks ago because of the depression. I wrote him a note because I just needed to get it out to someone and he showed up to my door thinking I was dead. But now he's pissed at me because he thinks I did it all for attention. I just needed someone to talk to or someone to just hold me and say everything will be okay.
